item.title: Corey Parker, ‘Will & Grace’ and ‘Friday the 13th’ actor, dies at 60, reports say
item.description: Corey Parker, known for his roles in “Will & Grace” and “Friday the 13th: A New Beginning,” has died, according to reports.

item.title: Pixar’s ‘Hoppers’ bounds to No. 1 as Warner Bros.’ ‘The Bride!’ is on life support
item.description: Disney and Pixar debuts its new film "Hoppers" and Warner Bros. releases "The Bride." Which films rocked the box office this week? Find out here.

item.title: Kansas City airport evacuated after possible threat, FBI investigating
item.description: The Kansas City Aviation Department confrimed the evacuation to KCTV and said KCI Airport Police are working with the FBI to determine if the threat is credible.

item.title: A 7th American is killed in Iran operations, military confirms
item.description: The U.S. military announced an American service member has died of injuries sustained during an Iranian attack on troops stationed in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father as supreme leader
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei, son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named his successor.

item.title: Julianna Fallon crowned Miss Teen Volunteer America 2027
item.description: A new Miss Teen Volunteer America was crowned Saturday night in the Hub City, and we spoke with the winner.

item.title: Refresh Ministries celebrates its grand opening weekend
item.description: One church in Jackson is celebrating a new beginning.

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: The price for a barrel of Brent crude, the international standard, was at $101.19 shortly after trading resumed on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, up 9.2% from its settlement price of $92.69 Friday.

item.title: Active Weather Through the First Half of the Week
item.description: Tonight: We’ll see temperatures drop down to the mid-40s as high pressure builds into the region. Skies will be clear and winds will be calm. Closer to sunrise, a light southerly breeze will kick up as some potential for thunderstorms moves into the area on Monday. Monday: Monday starts a stretch of active weather threats to West Tennessee. Monday afternoon...
